item.title: ConformTXT 0.6.6
item.description: - Fixed: in Mimestream and Mail, text pasted into the middle of a line could come in larger and in a serif font. It now always matches the text around it. - Plain sentences paste as plain text where ConformTXT can't read the font, so the app types them in its own font. - Safari: pastes into web email (Gmail, Outlook) now match the font too.
